# Quince

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 21 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

Quince is a public apparel, home, and beauty shop. This package is a signed-out capture of [https://www.quince.com](https://www.quince.com) on 2026-11-22. Prices on the product page read USD. Locale en-US. Desktop width measured 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The homepage, one category, one product, About Us, and the empty sign-in wall were photographed. Nothing was typed, submitted, or signed in.

`catalog.json` was left alone. `webapps-manifest.json` was left alone. `login-extracted` was not flipped.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the page white and the type ink.** The header is `#ffffff`. Nav, titles, and Add to Bag type are `#21201f`. [screenshots/home-light-1440.png](screenshots/home-light-1440.png)
- **Use cantaloupe for the one loud control.** Search, Shop Now, and Add to Bag are `#ffa273`. Holiday Gifts is the only rust label, `#bc5a28`. [screenshots/product-light-1440.png](screenshots/product-light-1440.png)
- **Use a pill for the primary action and a square chip for size.** Add to Bag is 52px with radius `9999px`. Size chips are 40 by 56px with radius `0`. [screenshots/product-light-1440.png](screenshots/product-light-1440.png)
- **Stop at the empty email wall.** Sign in and Register share one page. It asks for email and offers Continue with Google. Neither was used. [screenshots/login-light-1440.png](screenshots/login-light-1440.png)
